#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

const int INF = INT_MAX / 3;

int count(int pos, int start, const vector<int>& lst) {
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = start; i < (int)lst.size(); i++) {
        if (lst[i] < pos) ans++;
    }
    return ans;
}

int solve(const string& s) {
    vector<int> vPos, kPos, otherPos;
    int n = s.size();
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (s[i] == 'V') vPos.push_back(i);
        else if (s[i] == 'K') kPos.push_back(i);
        else otherPos.push_back(i);
    }
    int vSize = vPos.size();
    int kSize = kPos.size();
    int oSize = otherPos.size();

    // dp[last][V][K][O]
    vector<vector<vector<vector<int>>>> dp(2,
        vector<vector<vector<int>>>(vSize + 1,
            vector<vector<int>>(kSize + 1,
                vector<int>(oSize + 1, INF))));
    dp[0][0][0][0] = 0;

    for (int V = 0; V <= vSize; V++) {
        for (int K = 0; K <= kSize; K++) {
            for (int O = 0; O <= oSize; O++) {
                for (int last = 0; last < 2; last++) {
                    int cur = dp[last][V][K][O];
                    if (cur == INF) continue;
                    if (V < vSize) {
                        int add = count(vPos[V], K, kPos) + count(vPos[V], O, otherPos);
                        dp[1][V+1][K][O] = min(dp[1][V+1][K][O], cur + add);
                    }
                    if (K < kSize && last == 0) {
                        int add = count(kPos[K], V, vPos) + count(kPos[K], O, otherPos);
                        dp[0][V][K+1][O] = min(dp[0][V][K+1][O], cur + add);
                    }
                    if (O < oSize) {
                        int add = count(otherPos[O], V, vPos) + count(otherPos[O], K, kPos);
                        dp[0][V][K][O+1] = min(dp[0][V][K][O+1], cur + add);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return min(dp[0][vSize][kSize][oSize], dp[1][vSize][kSize][oSize]);
}

int main() {
    int n;
    string s;
    cin >> n >> s;
    cout << solve(s) << endl;
    return 0;
}
